rationale: Since yesterday's midday report the range top finally cracked -- a confirmed 1H close at 84,724 (05:00 COT) broke the prior addIf (84,628.2) -- but the breakout failed to extend, wicking to a fresh high of 85,258.8 before fading back under 84,000. The reduceIf floor (82,874.5) was never re-tested (session low 83,174.7 held a comfortable buffer above it). Daily structure is unchanged and fully bullish (price above all four EMAs), but the daily MACD histogram keeps decelerating into a 6th straight session (364.09 -> 242.27), so momentum is fading faster even as price probes new highs. With price now sitting closer to the defended support than the twice-rejected resistance, and $78 of cash sitting idle, deploying a modest tranche into the spot core near the low-mid of the range is a low-risk way to keep the desk active rather than just marking time -- keeping most of the cash in reserve in case 82,874.5 is tested for real.

message.text: Range top rejected twice now (84,724 confirmed close + 85,258.8 wick) without holding -- raised addIf to 84,944.4, needs a settled close above that to mean anything. reduceIf (82,874.5) still fully unbroken. Deployed a small 25 USDT DCA tranche into spot near 83,963.

lesson.pattern: A single confirmed close above a range-top level that fails to extend and rolls back within a few hours
lesson.insight: One settled close beyond a level is necessary but not sufficient -- when price immediately gives it back without building a new higher-low structure above the old level, treat the level as still contested and raise the confirmation bar to the next swing high rather than assuming the range has resolved.
